findings.summary: test:triad was omitted from the test:cloudflare Gate G command; added.
Cloudflare Native Auth workflow referenced nonexistent test:cloudflare-native-auth; corrected to test:auth.
Radar Backend Triad workflow referenced nonexistent test:geo; corrected to test:geography-catalog.
IRNI Geographic RPC workflow referenced missing test:irni-geographic-rpc and typecheck:irni-geographic-rpc package scripts; both added.
Cloudflare Workers Builds selected a stale Bun lockfile and failed before the frontend build; remove bun.lock and pin npm@10.9.2.

limitations: The authorized MacBook Desktop Commander device is Offline.

Five GitHub Actions jobs were assigned runner_id=0 with empty runner_name and zero steps; they failed within 2–5 seconds. This confirms runner allocation did not occur; no application test command was reached.
One rerun of the CI quality-gates job repeated the same runner_id=0, empty runner_name, zero-step failure.
Job logs are unavailable and no diagnostic artifacts were produced.
GitHub public status page listed Actions operational with no incident on 2026-11-27; repository/account-specific runner settings or quota remain uninspected.

Cloudflare Preview build bdf2e772-1133-486a-98bf-f1d26c81355a failed during bun install --frozen-lockfile before the build command; the stale Bun lockfile has been removed and npm pinned, but a fresh build is pending.
next_action: Verify a fresh Cloudflare Preview uses npm and reaches the frontend build; restore GitHub Actions runner allocation, then run the exact test matrix.
